unstuck_said.text: Filed checked feature request (dograh-hq/dograh#935, OPEN): a Nano (XNO) settlement option on hosted model-service/MPS usage billing. Grounded in api/services/workflow_run_billing.py (Dograh reports usage to MPS which owns credit accounting) and api/services/mps_billing.py. Asked whether hosted MPS bills the operator directly and whether a new settlement asset beside card/credits is acceptable.
